who: I want to hear live music
title: Live music in London, six nights a week
promise: Tell us what you love and we'll find your night: blues, soul, singer-songwriters, cult legends or the next big voice.

steps.title: Find your night
steps.text: Every night at TAM, with times and prices, and tickets sold by TAM itself.
steps.label: What's on

steps.title: Follow the artists you love
steps.text: Get an email when they're next on. One click to stop.
steps.label: Artists

steps.title: Christmas at TAM
steps.text: Twenty-one nights of The Best Christmas Ever, from £10.
steps.label: The festival

steps.title: Come early, stay late
steps.text: Street food from over 20 cuisines at Mercato Metropolitano, and drinks poured from taps built into old pianos.
steps.label: Find us

questions: Something bluesy for a date night
askLine: Ask me what’s on, and what you’ll love

title: Play TAM
promise: TAM was built to give artists a real stage, a real audience and a real shot. Here's how to get on it.

steps.title: Jam with us
steps.text: The Great British Blues Jam is a TAM weekly: all musicians welcome to come and play.
steps.label: Weekly nights

steps.title: Sing at the Sunday Spot
steps.text: TAM Singers: perform in front of a live audience, get filmed and recorded, and you may be invited back for special sessions.
steps.label: TAM Singers

steps.title: Young artists
steps.text: Junior Open Mic and TAM Open Music Academy put young players on the same stage as the headliners.
steps.label: Junior Open Mic

steps.title: Pitch a night
steps.text: Got a band, a collective or a scene? Tell us and we'll talk about a date.
steps.label: Pitch us

questions: How do I get a gig at TAM?
Can my band take over a night?
Is there anything for young players?
askLine: Ask me how to get on TAM’s stage

who: I want to hire the venue
title: Hire TAM
promise: A gallery of art and rescued pianos with a stage, a private bar and pro sound. Birthdays, launches, corporate nights and shoots.

steps.title: The space
steps.text: Up to 150 guests: 50–70 seated, or 70–120 for a cocktail-style reception. Any day of the week, priced by date and time.
steps.label: The space

steps.title: What's included
steps.text: A private bar with themed cocktails or mocktails, a stage and pro AV with a projector, and live music or karaoke if you want it.
steps.label: Amenities

steps.title: Shoots and content
steps.text: Pro sound and lighting, curated art and decorative pianos make a ready-made set for performances and product films.
steps.label: Video shoots

steps.title: Ask for a date
steps.text: Tell us the date, the guest count and what you're planning, and we'll come back with a quote.
steps.label: Enquire

questions: Can we hire it on a Saturday night?
Can we film a music video there?
askLine: Ask me about hiring the room

title: Your party, our stage
promise: Christmas with the team, a birthday, a reunion. Book a table on a festival night, or take over the whole room.

steps.title: Christmas parties
steps.text: Groups of 6+ save up to 15%, startup packs save 20%, and small teams can share a Team Table on any festival night.
steps.label: Book a festival night

steps.title: Put your brand on the wall
steps.text: Booked your party? Pin your company to the Party Wall.
steps.label: The Party Wall

steps.title: Go big
steps.text: Sponsor a night: tickets, a TAM Christmas Box for every guest, and your name on the festival.
steps.label: Sponsorship

steps.title: Have the room to yourselves
steps.text: Private hire for up to 150 guests, any day of the week.
steps.label: Private hire

questions: Christmas party for 12 people, what's best?
Is there a discount for groups?
Can we have the whole venue?
askLine: Ask me how to throw your party here

title: Partner with TAM
promise: Put your name on nights London remembers, with a crowd that's there for the music.

steps.title: Sponsor a festival night
steps.text: Bauble, Star and Shard packages, each with tickets and a TAM Christmas Box per guest.
steps.label: Packages

steps.title: Host a night
steps.text: Launches, community nights and takeovers with your audience and our stage.
steps.label: Hire the room

steps.title: Content that lasts
steps.text: Nights at TAM become films on TAM TV.
steps.label: TAM TV

steps.text: Tell us what you have in mind.
